sql: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('simulation_jobs','simulation_job_leases','simulation_job_attempts','simulation_job_events','simulation_operational_leases_v1','simulation_local_publications_v1','simulation_publication_confirmations_v1') ORDER BY name LIMIT 7

values.name: simulation_job_attempts
values.sql:
CREATE TABLE simulation_job_attempts (
                    job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    worker_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    ended_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    result TEXT NOT NULL,
                    error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    artifact_paths_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                    PRIMARY KEY(job_id, attempt),
                    FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES simulation_jobs(job_id)
                )

values.name: simulation_job_events
values.sql:
CREATE TABLE simulation_job_events (
                    event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    stream_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                    previous_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    next_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    reason_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                    source TEXT NOT NULL,
                    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES simulation_jobs(job_id)
                )

values.name: simulation_job_leases
values.sql:
CREATE TABLE simulation_job_leases (
                    lease_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    worker_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    acquired_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    heartbeat_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    released_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES simulation_jobs(job_id)
                )

values.name: simulation_jobs
values.sql:
CREATE TABLE simulation_jobs (
                    job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                    batch_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    backend TEXT NOT NULL,
                    scenario_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    control_mode TEXT NOT NULL,
                    seed INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    manifest_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    reproducibility_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL,
                    draft_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                    priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    queued_at TEXT,
                    started_at TEXT,
                    completed_at TEXT,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    timeout_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    worker_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    lease_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    lease_expires_at TEXT,
                    blocker_codes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                    error_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    error_message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    artifact_root TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    artifact_paths_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                    provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
                    source_commit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    source_tree_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
                )

values.name: simulation_local_publications_v1
values.sql: CREATE TABLE simulation_local_publications_v1 (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, operation_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, lease_id TEXT NOT NULL, epoch TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, row_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, phase TEXT NOT NULL, event_record_hash TEXT NOT NULL, event_receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL, job_receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL)

values.name: simulation_operational_leases_v1
values.sql:
CREATE TABLE simulation_operational_leases_v1 (
                    lease_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, schema TEXT NOT NULL,
                    job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, worker_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    attempt INTEGER, lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL,
                    pid INTEGER NOT NULL, boot_id TEXT NOT NULL, process_start_ticks INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    epoch TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, row_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    original_job_digest TEXT NOT NULL, original_policy_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
                    original_acquisition_json TEXT NOT NULL, segment_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL, operation_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                    job_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, proposed_row_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
                    durable_phase TEXT NOT NULL, terminal_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES simulation_jobs(job_id)
                )

values.name: simulation_publication_confirmations_v1
values.sql: CREATE TABLE simulation_publication_confirmations_v1 (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, epoch TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','CONFIRMED')), job_receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL, event_receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL, artifact_manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, confirmation_hash TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(run_id,attempt))

SELECT job_id,run_id,status,attempt,worker_id,lease_id,started_at,completed_at,updated_at,error_code,error_message FROM simulation_jobs ORDER BY job_id LIMIT 4
SELECT lease_id,job_id,worker_id,acquired_at,expires_at,heartbeat_at,released_at FROM simulation_job_leases ORDER BY lease_id LIMIT 4
SELECT job_id,run_id,attempt,worker_id,started_at,ended_at,result,error FROM simulation_job_attempts ORDER BY attempt DESC,job_id LIMIT 8

SELECT lease_id,job_id,run_id,attempt,lifecycle,pid,epoch,generation,row_revision,proposal_id,operation_sha256,durable_phase,terminal_reason,length(original_acquisition_json) AS acquisition_bytes,length(job_snapshot_json) AS snapshot_bytes FROM simulation_operational_leases_v1 ORDER BY job_id LIMIT 4
SELECT event_type,count(*) AS rows,min(sequence) AS first_sequence,max(sequence) AS last_sequence FROM simulation_job_events GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_type LIMIT 64

SELECT event_id,job_id,run_id,sequence,stream_sequence,event_type,previous_status,next_status,reason_code,timestamp,source,length(payload_json) AS payload_bytes,CASE WHEN length(CAST(payload_json AS BLOB))<=262144 THEN payload_json ELSE NULL END AS bounded_payload_json FROM simulation_job_events ORDER BY stream_sequence DESC LIMIT 32
SELECT phase,count(*) AS rows,min(rowid) AS first_rowid,max(rowid) AS last_rowid FROM simulation_local_publications_v1 GROUP BY phase ORDER BY phase LIMIT 16

SELECT rowid,operation_id,operation_sha256,job_id,attempt,lease_id,epoch,generation,row_revision,phase,event_record_hash,event_receipt_hash,job_receipt_hash,length(payload_json) AS payload_bytes,CASE WHEN length(CAST(payload_json AS BLOB))<=262144 THEN payload_json ELSE NULL END AS bounded_payload_json FROM simulation_local_publications_v1 ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 24
SELECT state,count(*) AS rows FROM simulation_publication_confirmations_v1 GROUP BY state ORDER BY state LIMIT 8
SELECT category,count(*) AS rows FROM visual_local_tasks_v1 GROUP BY category ORDER BY category LIMIT 32

SELECT category,record_key,task_id,length(value_json) AS payload_bytes,CASE WHEN length(CAST(value_json AS BLOB))<=262144 THEN value_json ELSE NULL END AS bounded_payload_json FROM visual_local_tasks_v1 ORDER BY category,record_key LIMIT 16
SELECT phase,count(*) AS rows,min(rowid) AS first_rowid,max(rowid) AS last_rowid FROM visual_local_publications_v1 GROUP BY phase ORDER BY phase LIMIT 16

SELECT rowid,operation_id,operation_sha256,job_id,attempt,lease_id,epoch,generation,row_revision,phase,event_record_hash,event_receipt_hash,job_receipt_hash,length(payload_json) AS payload_bytes,CASE WHEN length(CAST(payload_json AS BLOB))<=262144 THEN payload_json ELSE NULL END AS bounded_payload_json FROM visual_local_publications_v1 ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 16
SELECT bootstrap_id,job_id,run_id,revision,definition_hash,record_hash,length(payload_json) AS payload_bytes FROM visual_bootstraps ORDER BY bootstrap_id LIMIT 4
SELECT task_id,revision,definition_hash,record_hash,length(payload_json) AS payload_bytes FROM visual_supervision ORDER BY task_id LIMIT 4
SELECT task_id,owner_revision,owner_epoch,state_generation,publication_hash,length(payload_json) AS payload_bytes FROM visual_owner_publications ORDER BY task_id,owner_revision DESC LIMIT 4
